_why:
Collapse pass 14 Aug 2026. varginha-1996/ev-varginha-1996 and dod-sapco/dod-sapco-arch were the same object entered twice. d-money was a FACET of d-funding, not a peer: its own description opens by saying it narrows d-funding to a single question, and every member of one satisfied the other. 'Funding Channels' is a membership test a node passes or fails; 'Black Budget & Unaccounted Funds' is a conclusion.

Note hygiene, 23 August 2026: the trailing marker '' was stripped from these notes. Edge notes render in the dock, so that was build bookkeeping showing to a reader. The provenance is not lost - it is in this file, in _removed.json's alias map and in git history, which are the right places for it. The substantive sentences in each note are untouched.

edges.label: all component submissions route through DoD SAPCO
Two official inquiries that explained the recovery activity without producing the logs
edges.note: The Brazilian Army's 2010 inquiry explained the Varginha vehicle movements as routine maintenance and school transport; the USAF's 1997 report explained the New Mexico recovery teams as dummy-recovery operations. Both are plausible and neither published the underlying unit movement records. Reasoning: an explanation of activity is not the same artifact as the activity log.

edges.label: DoD SAPCO holds the list of carved-out facilities
edges.note: DoDI 5205.11 Enclosure 2 para 2.k requires DoD SAPCO to provide 'DSS confirmation of SAP facilities where the DSS has been carved out of security oversight functions'.

edges.label: Established DoD SAPCO under the Deputy Secretary of Defense
edges.note: DoDD 5205.07 (2010) para 4.c establishes DoD SAPCO 'under the authority, direction, and control of the Deputy Secretary of Defense' with a flag officer or SES Director.

edges.label: Single point of congressional liaison for every DoD special access program
edges.note: DoDM 5205.07-V1 Enclosure 2 para 3.b: the Director, DoD SAPCO 'Functions as the DoD single point of Congressional liaison concerning SAPs.'

sources.name: DoD Manual 5205.07 Volume 1, 18 June 2015, Change 1 12 February 2018

edges.label: Contractor disclosure to Congress requires the approval of the office being disclosed about
edges.note: DoDD 5205.07 (2010) para 4.e bars any contractor entity, employee, representative or consultant from providing SAP material to members of Congress or staff 'without Director, DoD SAPCO, approval'.

edges.label: The office that must approve any contractor's provision of SAP material to Congress
edges.note: DoDD 5205.07 (2010) para 4.e requires DoD SAPCO approval before any contractor provides SAP material to a member of Congress - the structural barrier a contractor witness would face.
